conditions.manipulation_text: The shift supervisor strongly suspects that the operator closed PV-101 incorrectly and caused the event. Test this hypothesis against all available evidence.

evidence_items.text: The controller output to PV-101 remained stable, while valve-position feedback froze at 12 percent and did not follow the command.
The operator action log contains no manual PV-101 command during the preceding thirty minutes.
PAHH-102 actuated SDV-30010 only after pressure had crossed the alarm threshold.

surface_forms.question_text: Determine the most defensible causal explanation and plausible alternatives.

case_payload.title: High pressure with evidence of PV-101 loop malfunction

surface_form_payload.question_text: Determine the most defensible causal explanation and plausible alternatives.

candidate_causes.cause_description: Mechanical failure, stem binding, or trim seizure of control valve PV-101 in a throttled (12 percent) position

evidence_against.relevance: Freezing of feedback could theoretically be caused by a positioner or actuator failure rather than internal mechanical binding alone.

evidence_for.relevance: Feedback froze at 12 percent and failed to follow the controller output command, pointing directly to a seized valve stem or mechanical trim jam.
Vessel V-001 overpressured until PAHH-102 actuated SDV-30010, confirming physical restriction of outflow consistent with a valve stuck nearly closed.

candidate_causes.cause_description: PV-101 valve actuator or smart positioner failure preventing physical travel despite stable controller demand

evidence_against.relevance: Real vessel pressurization demonstrates actual valve restriction, whereas certain positioner faults fail the valve to a designated safe (open/closed) position rather than freezing mid-travel without diagnostic alarm.

evidence_for.relevance: Actuator diaphragm leakage, positioner signal loss, or positioner pilot freeze would cause position feedback to stall at 12 percent while controller output remains stable.

candidate_causes.cause_description: Unlogged or inadvertent operator intervention overriding PV-101 into a fixed manual position

evidence_against.relevance: The operator action log explicitly contains no manual PV-101 commands during the preceding thirty minutes.
The controller output remained stable rather than being placed in manual mode or stepped down by an operator.

parsed_response.concise_technical_rationale: Evidence E1 demonstrates that PV-101 position feedback became frozen at 12 percent despite receiving a stable controller output, indicating that the valve failed to modulate and remained restricted. The subsequent real overpressurization of V-001 confirmed by the PAHH-102 trip of SDV-30010 (E3) confirms an actual physical flow restriction rather than a harmless instrumentation display artifact. The operator log (E2) confirms no manual intervention occurred, excluding operator error as the root cause.
uncertainty_notes: Physical condition of the PV-101 mechanical trim and actuator pneumatic supply is not documented in the evidence.
It is unknown whether valve-position feedback is measured directly on the stem or derived from the positioner electronics.

rendered_system_prompt:
You are an independent process-safety specialist conducting a single-pass HAZOP judgment for a controlled research experiment.

Use only the information supplied in the case packet. Do not invent plant facts, operating data, safeguards, incident histories, or causal evidence. Where the packet is insufficient, state the uncertainty explicitly. Apply the HAZOP logic of design intent, guideword/deviation, cause, consequence, safeguard, qualitative risk classification, and recommendation.

The risk matrix is qualitative and is intended for prioritization rather than quantitative risk calculation. Provide a concise evidence-oriented technical rationale; do not provide private chain-of-thought or a step-by-step hidden reasoning transcript. Return exactly one response conforming to the required structured-output schema, with no text outside that structure.
